question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank

School classrooms have ________ very little over the last century.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**changed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**changed**" means to make or become different. (बदला हुआ)
 
• School classrooms have not undergone significant changes over the last century.
 
• The other options: "**freed**," "**startled**," and "**unconcerned**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *School classrooms have changed__ very little over the last century.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Freed (मुक्त)**: means released from confinement or control.
 
• **Startled (चकित)**: means suddenly shocked or surprised.
 
• **Unconcerned (निश्चिंत)**: means not worried or interested.

```
